events.text: Phage Press publishes the original 256-page Amber Diceless RPG book

evidence.quote: Wujcik then founded Phage Press , and published Amber Diceless Role-playing in 1991
The original 256-page game book was published in 1991 by Phage Press

events.text: Shadow Knight companion rulebook for the game is published

evidence.quote: A 256-page companion volume , Shadow Knight , was published in 1993

events.text: Jeux Descartes publishes a French translation of one of the two books

evidence.quote: Both books were translated into French and published by Jeux Descartes in 1994 and 1995

events.text: Jeux Descartes publishes a French translation of the other book

evidence.quote: Both books were translated into French and published by Jeux Descartes in 1994 and 1995

events.text: Publishing rights to Amber DRPG acquired by Guardians of Order

evidence.quote: The publishing rights to the Amber DRPG games were acquired in 2004 by Guardians of Order

events.text: New publisher Diceless by Design formed to bring the game back into print

evidence.quote: In June 2007 a new publishing company , headed by Edwin Voskamp and Eric Todd , was formed

events.label: license
events.text: Rite Publishing secured a license from Diceless by Design to use the rules system for a new product

evidence.quote: In May 2010 , Rite Publishing secured a license from Diceless by Design to use the rules system

events.text: Lords of Gossamer and Shadow (Diceless), built on the game's rules, released publicly in print and PDF

evidence.quote: Nov 2013 Lords of Gossamer and Shadow ( Diceless ) was released publicly
